plan.description: Load the raw single-cell RNA-seq dataset using Scanpy to generate an initial AnnData object. This step involves reading the .h5ad file and initializing the data structure for subsequent analysis.
input_filename: ./data/cell_annotation/dataset_debug_restricted.h5ad: A single-cell RNA-seq dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes and gene names.
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/initialized_dataset.h5ad: Initialized AnnData object containing raw gene expression matrix and metadata

plan.description: Perform quality control (QC) on the dataset by filtering cells with high mitochondrial gene percentage (>=20%), low total UMIs (<500) and an insufficient number of detected genes. This will yield a filtered AnnData object containing high-quality cells for downstream analysis.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/initialized_dataset.h5ad: Initialized AnnData object containing raw gene expression matrix and metadata
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/qc_filtered_dataset.h5ad: Quality-controlled AnnData object with filtered high-quality cells

plan.description: Normalize the QC-filtered data and identify highly variable genes (HVGs). This step uses scanpy.pp.normalize_total, scanpy.pp.log1p and scanpy.pp.highly_variable_genes to standardize the expression levels and extract features that are informative for subsequent clustering and marker analysis.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/qc_filtered_dataset.h5ad: Quality-controlled AnnData object with filtered high-quality cells
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/normalized_hvg_dataset.h5ad: Normalized AnnData object with selected highly variable genes

plan.description: Reduce the dimensionality using PCA and compute the neighborhood graph. Perform clustering analysis using the Leiden algorithm and generate a UMAP visualization. This step assigns cluster labels to cells based on their transcriptomic profiles, which will assist in downstream identification of malignant clusters.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/normalized_hvg_dataset.h5ad: Normalized AnnData object with selected highly variable genes
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/clustering_results.h5ad: AnnData object with PCA, neighborhood graph, cluster labels and UMAP coordinates

plan.description: Identify differentially expressed marker genes across the clusters using a single-cell marker gene identification workflow. Differential expression analysis between clusters will help pinpoint gene markers that are associated with malignancy. Criteria such as adjusted p-value (<0.05) and logFC (>1) will be used to select high-confidence markers.
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/marker_genes_table.txt: Table of differentially expressed marker genes with logFC, p-values, and adj_pvals

plan.description: Integrate the clustering results and marker gene expression profiles to classify cells as malignant or non-malignant. This step uses known malignancy-associated gene markers and the expression patterns observed across clusters to identify potentially malignant cells. The final output is a summarized classification of cells based on their malignant status.
input_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/marker_genes_table.txt: Table of differentially expressed marker genes
output_filename: ./output/cell_annotation_o3mini_instruct/malignant_cells_classification.txt: Final classification results listing cells annotated as malignant along with supporting marker gene evidence
plan.tools: Scanpy, single-cell data marker gene identification
